description:
Optional SwingBridge Emulators add-on: the host-app wiring a migrated app needs
        on Spring Boot — a SpringServlet with a virtual-thread-aware session lock, and an
        auto-configuration that registers it and SwingBridgeEmulatorsBootstrap. A separate
        artifact so its Spring dependency stays off the classpath of migrated apps that run on
        Vaadin Boot or a plain servlet container.
